text:
Luca: kicking off the StratusLane joint pilot — quick sync tomorrow 11am PT. goal: validate embeddings + chat workflow at ~200 rps, 95th pct latency target <300ms. need tech owners, network, and security signoffs.
Sam: who owns pricing for the POC? partner expects an estimate for 2 weeks of tests. do we push hosted credits or reserved capacity? :thinking_face:
Raj: pinging infra questions — which region do they want? egress/VPC peering required? do we need a private endpoint or just API keys?
Emily: security checklist: we need a completed vendor questionnaire, SOC2 PDF, and privacy contact. can StratusLane share an asset classification and data retention policy?
Maya - StratusLane: thanks — I'm Maya (tech lead). we can do us-west-2 staging. we will avoid PHI, only product text. we prefer SAML SSO and can do VPC peering if needed. I can get the security questionnaire back by EOD tomorrow.
Luca: perfect. infra-bot, please spin up a staging tenant for stratuslane-poc in us-west-2 and attach a short runbook link. Sam, can you draft a ballpark pricing note we can share with them?
infra-bot: Tenant provisioning requested by Luca. creating tenant...
infra-bot: Tenant created: id=tn-3421, region=us-west-2, endpoint=https://us-west-2.redwood.example/tenants/tn-3421 :white_check_mark:
Sam: ballpark — for hosted API at expected volume (200rps sustained, mix of embeddings+chat) estimate ~USD 1,800-2,500/day with caching. Dedicated reserved estimate (short term 2w) would be cheaper per-token but requires min commit. I'll send a short breakdown. :moneybag:
Raj: network checklist: allow outbound to our endpoint on 443, allow inbound VPC peering CIDR 10.12.0.0/16 if they opt for peering. if they want metrics scraping, open port 9090 from their monitoring IPs.
Emily: adding security contacts — please send questionnaire to security@redwood.example. we need an owner on the StratusLane side for follow-ups. HIPAA not in scope but include data retention window.
Maya - StratusLane: putting in names: infra@stratuslane.com (ops), secops@stratuslane.com (security). we will fill the questionnaire tonight. one ask: can you support a quantized 7B model variant to reduce cost?
Luca: yes. we can propose a canary that falls back to the full 13B model if quality requirements fail. config example I'll add to the runbook:
```
redwoodctl rollout create --tenant tn-3421 --model redwood-7b-quant --fallback redwood-13b --canary 10%
```
Sam: thanks — I'll prepare a 1-page cost note vs. performance tradeoffs and share it before the 11am sync.
Raj: I'll post the minimal firewall/VPC peering guide to the runbook.
Emily: I'll attach the vendor questionnaire (template) and SOC2 link to the thread.
Maya - StratusLane: great — we'll have answers by tomorrow morning. looking forward to the sync. :thumbsup:
Luca: awesome. agenda for tomorrow: 1) network & tenant status 2) security signoffs 3) pricing + rollout plan 4) next steps. see you all at 11am PT.
